title: SlideSemanticRegistration
description: Registration of teacher-stamped source slides against the episode claim ledger, plus verbatim figure extraction. Closes the one-sided semantic join recorded in doc 29 section 8.19: cues carry claim_refs, evidence surfaces do not. One document per deck. Files are never renamed — slide_id and the bound sha256 stay frozen and semantic_id is an added alias.

registered_by.description: Model or operator that produced this registration.

slide_id.description: Existing id from the deck manifest. Copied verbatim, never altered — it is the join key to the bound asset.

sha256.description: Copied verbatim from the supplied index. The validator rejects any mismatch; a wrong hash means the wrong slide was read.

semantic_id.description: Added alias, NOT a filename. Form: <primary-claim>.<role>.<form>-v<n>. The claim segment MUST be claim_refs[0] so the id is a lookup key rather than a label.

headline.description: The single assertion this slide makes, in the operator's voice. Not the slide's printed title unless the title is itself the assertion.

claim_refs.description: Claim ids from the supplied ledger ONLY, ordered by centrality — claim_refs[0] is what the slide principally evidences. Never invent an id. An empty array is valid and must be paired with unmatched_reason.

unmatched_reason.description: Required when claim_refs is empty. Says what the slide is about and why no ledger claim covers it. This is the sanctioned escape hatch; guessing a claim is not.

taxonomy.description: Terms from the supplied taxonomy only. Omit an axis rather than inventing a term.

figures.description: Every numeral printed on the slide that states a fact. Decorative numbers (page numbers, axis ticks, footnote markers) are excluded. An empty array is valid for a slide with no figures.

confidence.description: Self-assessed. Use low when the slide is dense, ambiguous, or the claim match is a stretch — low-confidence rows get human review rather than silent trust.

value.description: The numeral EXACTLY as typeset on the slide, including symbols, separators and qualifiers: "18%", "$140B+", "2 to 3", "~5 years", "11 Trillion won", "3.0 : 1". Never normalise, convert, round, or expand — this string is asserted to appear verbatim in the image and is checked against the badge that quotes it.

label.description: What the number measures, taken from the slide's own wording where possible.

unit.description: Unit or denomination when not already inside value.

period.description: Time period the figure covers, if stated (e.g. "2025-2026", "mid-2026", "FY Q3 2026").

context_sentence.description: The sentence or caption on the slide that carries this figure, transcribed. Establishes that the number means what the label says.

location.description: Where on the slide the figure appears. Required so a later crop can find it and a reviewer can verify it.

is_headline.description: True for the one or two figures a viewer should take away. These are the badge candidates.
